project.title: PixelCraft
project.tagline: A Flutter image editing project focused on GPU preview and reliability.

summary.short: PixelCraft is a Flutter image editing project with an emphasis on GPU-backed preview, camera/film workflows, and repeatable reliability validation on real devices.
summary.long: Current work includes GPU preview evolution, G6 reliability evidence, device-cycle verification, and closure documentation for production-oriented preview and editing workflows.
